add.name: NextAuthMiddleware
add.description: Edge middleware guarding /admin/** — verifies the httpOnly bw-session cookie (RS256 JWT) and admin role; redirects anonymous and non-admin visitors to /login. NEW (loc: anti-pattern 13 / finding 8).

add.name: AuthSessionCookie
add.description: Helpers to set/clear/verify the httpOnly bw-session cookie carrying the access token; shared by login route, logout route, and middleware. NEW.

add.name: LoginRoute
add.description: POST /api/auth/login — existing; MODIFIED to set the httpOnly bw-session cookie on successful login alongside the JSON token pair.

add.name: LogoutRoute
add.description: POST /api/auth/logout — NEW; clears the httpOnly bw-session cookie (client clears localStorage session).

add.name: Navigation
add.description: Site header — existing; MODIFIED to be session-aware: Sign in / Register when unauthenticated, user name + Sign out when authenticated (calls /api/auth/logout then clearSession).

add.name: GraphQLRoute
add.description: POST /api/graphql — existing; MODIFIED to run through createAuthMiddleware with real request headers into the resolver context; hardcoded 'Bearer token' removed (finding 1, HIGH).

add.name: middleware
add.description: Edge middleware entry: verifies bw-session cookie + admin role for /admin/**, redirects otherwise

add.name: setSessionCookie
add.description: Sets httpOnly bw-session cookie (access token) on login response

add.name: clearSessionCookie
add.description: Expires the bw-session cookie on logout

add.name: verifySessionCookie
add.description: Verifies + decodes the bw-session JWT (RS256) for middleware and server checks

add.name: LoginRoute POST
add.description: POST /api/auth/login — verifies credentials, issues tokens, sets bw-session cookie

add.name: LogoutRoute POST
add.description: POST /api/auth/logout — clears the session cookie, returns success envelope
